invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of either getUpsertPartitioner(profile) or getInsertPartitioner(profile), both of which should provide a non-null Partitioner.
The return value matches the branch taken based on the operation type.
The method is called with a non-null WorkloadProfile, as the profile parameter is dereferenced and used in both return paths.
The result returned from either branch must implement or be an instance of Partitioner.
Both factory methods for the result are expected to always return non-null Partitioners when given a valid profile.
